primary_rain.interpretation: small, directionally consistent association: multi-species calling is more common closer to recent rainfall

joint_weather_doy_robustness.interpretation: both weather associations persist after flexible day-of-year adjustment

external_validation.source: Sunshine Coast Annual Frog and Toad Field Survey
external_validation.reason: raw occurrenceRemarks contains HEA/SEE/SHD/HAN/OPP codes but current source documentation audited so far does not provide an explicit machine-actionable mapping sufficient to authorize HEA as calling evidence

current_claim: Warm conditions and recent rainfall are associated with greater event-level overlap in frog calling activity across a continental standardized monitoring network; seasonal-shoulder amplification and pairwise network densification are not supported.
unresolved_interpretation: event-level overlap may arise from increased overall calling activation rather than increased multispecies overlap conditional on a stop being acoustically active
